# MemOS core architecture for persistent AI memory
class MemOS:
    def __init__(self, agent_id, memory_capacity=1000000):
        self.agent_id = agent_id
        self.working_memory = WorkingMemory(capacity=8192)  # Current context
        self.episodic_memory = EpisodicMemory(capacity=memory_capacity)  # Session history
        self.semantic_memory = SemanticMemory()  # Learned knowledge
        self.memory_manager = MemoryManager()
        
    def process_input(self, input_text, session_id):
        # Add to working memory
        self.working_memory.add(input_text)
        
        # Store in episodic memory with session context
        episode = Episode(input_text, session_id, timestamp=time.now())
        self.episodic_memory.store(episode)
        
        # Extract semantic knowledge if applicable
        knowledge = self.extract_semantic_knowledge(input_text)
        if knowledge:
            self.semantic_memory.integrate(knowledge)
            
    def retrieve_relevant_memory(self, query, context_limit=2048):
        # Retrieve from all memory layers
        working_context = self.working_memory.get_current()
        relevant_episodes = self.episodic_memory.search(query, limit=10)
        semantic_knowledge = self.semantic_memory.query(query)
        
        # Compose unified memory context within limits
        memory_context = self.memory_manager.compose_context(
            working_context, relevant_episodes, semantic_knowledge,
            max_tokens=context_limit
        )
        return memory_context

# Memory consolidation for long-term storage
class MemoryConsolidation:
    def __init__(self, consolidation_threshold=1000):
        self.threshold = consolidation_threshold
        
    def consolidate_episodes(self, episodic_memory):
        # Compress old episodes into semantic knowledge
        old_episodes = episodic_memory.get_episodes_older_than(days=7)
        
        if len(old_episodes) > self.threshold:
            # Extract patterns and knowledge from episodes
            patterns = self.extract_patterns(old_episodes)
            knowledge = self.distill_knowledge(old_episodes)
            
            # Move to semantic memory and remove detailed episodes
            semantic_memory.integrate(patterns + knowledge)
            episodic_memory.archive(old_episodes)
```

- **Context Integration**: Seamlessly integrate retrieved memories with current context for continuity

class AgentContinuity:
    def __init__(self, agent_id, user_id):
        self.agent_id = agent_id
        self.user_id = user_id
        self.relationship_memory = RelationshipMemory()
        self.preference_model = UserPreferenceModel()
        self.project_state = ProjectStateManager()
        
    def start_new_session(self, session_context=None):
        # Retrieve relevant context from previous sessions
        relationship_context = self.relationship_memory.get_context(self.user_id)
        user_preferences = self.preference_model.get_preferences(self.user_id)
        active_projects = self.project_state.get_active_projects(self.user_id)
        
        # Initialize session with continuity context
        session = AgentSession(
            relationship_context=relationship_context,
            user_preferences=user_preferences,
            active_projects=active_projects,
            context=session_context
        )
        return session
        
    def end_session(self, session):
        # Extract and store learnings from session
        relationship_updates = session.extract_relationship_learnings()
        preference_updates = session.extract_preference_learnings()
        project_updates = session.extract_project_progress()
        
        # Update persistent memory stores
        self.relationship_memory.update(relationship_updates)
        self.preference_model.update(preference_updates)
        self.project_state.update(project_updates)

# Long-term project management across sessions
class ProjectStateManager:
    def __init__(self):
        self.active_projects = {}
        self.project_history = []
        
    def create_project(self, user_id, project_type, initial_state):
        project_id = self.generate_project_id()
        project = Project(
            id=project_id,
            user_id=user_id,
            type=project_type,
            state=initial_state,
            created_at=time.now()
        )
        self.active_projects[project_id] = project
        return project_id
        
    def update_project_state(self, project_id, state_updates):
        if project_id in self.active_projects:
            project = self.active_projects[project_id]
            project.update_state(state_updates)
            project.last_updated = time.now()
            
    def get_active_projects(self, user_id):
        return [p for p in self.active_projects.values() if p.user_id == user_id]
```
